result.summary: Ran the full mix test suite twice, independently, against the real docker-compose Postgres (letflow-postgres-1, port 5462, confirmed Up/healthy). Run 1 (unpinned/random seed 275600): '4 properties, 411 tests, 0 failures' (Finished in 12.2 seconds). Run 2 (pinned seed 0, second independent run per this project's established double-run practice): '4 properties, 411 tests, 0 failures' (Finished in 13.4 seconds). Both logs saved to /tmp and programmatically grepped for failure markers (Failures:/Failure:/failure:/** (/Excluded:/Skipped:/Doctests:) -- zero matches beyond the '0 failures' summary line itself. Also ran an isolated re-run of this run's own new file, mix test test/letflow/event_store_test.exs: '10 tests, 0 failures' (matches TEST-DESIGNER's and TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's own prior isolated runs). Count arithmetic verified against the actual run rather than assumed: 401 (handoff-cited baseline at commit aac8f256, confirmed an ancestor of this branch's HEAD 46dce47 via git merge-base --is-ancestor) + 10 (new file) = 411, matching the actual full-suite total exactly. No pre-existing failures found anywhere in the suite -- nothing to file per ISSUE_QUEUE.md, Unblock-Everything rule not triggered. Independently re-queried Postgres directly after both runs (docker exec ... psql): public.tenants and public.tenant_schemas both count 0 -- no orphan rows, confirming each test's sandbox/on_exit cleanup is the operative mechanism. Known pre-existing noise observed and not mistaken for failures: 2x OIDC placeholder-issuer connection-refused errors (pre-existing since REQ-016, documented in every prior WF-02 report), 27x [debug] QUERY ERROR lines from deliberate constraint-violation assertions elsewhere in the suite, and pre-existing deprecation/unused-default compiler warnings unrelated to REQ-025. Full detail, verbatim summary/finished lines, and file-by-file breakdown recorded in the report file.
